title: pouteria reticulata
intro: Pouteria reticulata, commonly known as the Brazil nut tree, is a tropical tree native to the Amazon rainforest. It is valued for its seeds, known as Brazil nuts, which have been found to possess numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Brazil nuts include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making them effective in reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of Brazil nuts include selenium, magnesium, and fatty acids, which contribute to their therapeutic actions.
